name: noveliaa
description: Author-owned creative writing: explore selected universes, research story questions and return traceable, unverified proposals without changing original writing.

interface.longDescription: Work with your private Noveliaa writing from ChatGPT. Browse only universes you allow, read exact cloud-saved revisions, explore story questions and return discussions, research, critiques or proposals for your review. Original writing stays untouched; all AI material remains unverified. Includes reusable skills for source-led story exploration, research and careful collaboration.
defaultPrompt: Explore the writing I have shared in Noveliaa.
Help me investigate a story question using my exact source revisions.
Critique this scene and save a separate, unverified proposal after I ask.
